# Tidy Traces editorial method

Website: https://tidytraces.com/
Reader origin: https://github.com/arpitbbhayani/the-daily-diff

Depth over noise. Distraction-free AI observability newspaper with original source links, useful summaries, explicitly sourced images, and dated edition history. There is no engineering edition or engineering navigation tab.

AI observability opens at /. Dated issues use /ai-observability/YYYY-MM-DD/, the calendar is /archive/, and RSS is /rss.xml. Markdown and JSON exports at /md and /json use the latest AI issue. Every story must have an original publication date in the declared previous-day story_window. Takeaways are separate from source claims. AI research and curation are manual. Empty issues are valid; missing days are not filled with older links.

Sources HN, NEWS, GITHUB are mutually exclusive discovery channels. Signal filters are All, Recommended (recorded score >= 8), and Must-Read (>= 9). Missing scores appear only under All. Topic categories are observability, evals, and agents.

Preserve supplied original image references. Only legacy /infographics/ paths use the original upstream CDN; other local image paths stay local. Never substitute an unrelated illustration.

The calendar shows publishing streaks from consecutive issue dates, not personal reading activity. All real AI issues are retained. The current repository contains one AI issue; no older ones are fabricated.
